sentences: Web3 has a compliance paradox.
Traditional KYC stores passports, faces, and addresses in centralized databases.
Fully anonymous DeFi gets shut down by regulators.
Until now, users had to choose: expose their privacy, or break the law.
And compliance never stops changing.
When a wallet hits a sanctions list, access may stay open for days because revocation depends on manual updates.
One centralized failure point, for users and protocols alike.
ZK-CID fixes both sides.
We combine decentralized identity with zero-knowledge proofs, so a user can prove I am compliant without revealing who I am.
The issuer verifies documents off-chain and stores only an anonymous commitment.
The protocol sees a valid proof, never the person's identity.
Let us see it live.
Step one. The user generates a Semaphore identity locally in the browser.
The private key never leaves the device.

sections.badge: STEP 2  |  ISSUER VERIFIES OFF-CHAIN, COMMITS ON-CHAIN
sentences: Step two. A trusted issuer verifies the user's documents off-chain.
Only the anonymous commitment is added to the on-chain compliance group.
Step three. To enter a regulated DeFi app, the user generates a zero-knowledge proof in the browser.
It proves approved-group membership and prevents replay.
ComplianceGate verifies it and mints the Access NFT.
Step four. When a sanctions list changes, the Chainlink CRE workflow matches on-chain members and revokes the credential automatically.
No manual update, no delay.
Under the hood: Semaphore v4 for anonymous membership, Solidity and Hardhat for on-chain verification, and a Next.js frontend on Scaffold-ETH 2.
Chainlink CRE orchestrates the complete compliance lifecycle.
This is not a mock-up. Contracts are deployed on Sepolia, and the end-to-end flow is covered by tests.
The CRE simulation executes fetch, match, report, and revoke.
Any DeFi protocol can integrate the gate without taking custody of user data.
Regulators get verifiable compliance. Users keep their privacy.
The live demo and open-source code are ready for judges to test.
ZK-CID: private by design, compliant by proof.
Thank you.
